text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Spe, over this way! El's already on
the call!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! Are you there, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Oh, sounds like Spe's arrived!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bonjour! You all seem in high spirits! Of
course, the same goes for
yours truly!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe, congrats on winning the spring Tenno
Sho! You did great as well,
Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah,
she really got me good this time..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"My pride has been so wounded that I
can't sleep at night. It's her
fault I keep
falling asleep in class..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Whaaat?! Wait, are you for real?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Sei is always falling asleep in class.
You
know that..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I got yelled at for sleeping in class
too... I
had swimming class right
before, and I
guess I went a little overboard..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Glad to see nothing's changed
back home.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your international G1
win, El! The news here can't
stop talking
about you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, seems I'm a real celebrity back
home! However! I will not be
satisfied with
this level of accomplishment!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to be the world's strongest!
That's why I will be taking on
a BIG race
no Japanese Umamusume has ever won
before!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"By taking home the gold at the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe, I will have
officially
achieved my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We're all rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just us.
All of Japan is behind
you, El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But as your friends—and your rivals—we all
expect to see an amazing
performance at
your next race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And I'm looking forward to seeing you
race, Grass! Don't you dare
forget, we
promised to race again someday!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, and I cannot wait... for that day.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now, let's talk about me next!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a minute, shouldn't I be next in
line?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hey! What about me?! I'm here too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The pack's turning the fourth corner into
the final stretch! This year's
Derby
Umamusume, Special Week, surges ahead
from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! Special Week takes the
lead! But senior racer Air
Groove "The
Empress" is closing in!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Swooping in, it's El Condor! El Condor! El
Condor Pasa takes the win
at the last
moment!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The distance proved no challenge for her!
Despite her inexperience
as a classic racer,
El Condor Pasa has conquered the Japan
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Wheeze!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That sure was one intense race, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Ehehe, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I'll never forget that Japan Cup...
El was
just so cool.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(After going up against such an amazing
runner, I realized I still had
more to give in
my races. I wouldn't have learned that
without her.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Just watching her gets my heart
beating...
That sensation must be
why everyone
expects so much from El.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, I wanna be an Umamusume like
that!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... a race that rounds
off the first half of the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As this grand stage approaches, Special
Week's fervor at training only
increases.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hraaauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
That's three laps on the dirt track!
Trainer, what should I do
next?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Let's do some incline training. Focus on
maintaining your speed

throughout—enough that you feel some
strain.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right! Okay, here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She sure is motivated, that Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's a reason she was number one in
the polls... But even
considering that, she's
been extra gung-ho lately.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
As long as she doesn't overdo it,
I see it as
a good thing. It just means
her heart's in
her training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Her heart's in her training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When we were aiming for the spring Tenno
Sho, we tried out all sorts
of techniques. I
suppose this is quite similar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was facing my dream head-on.
Perhaps Special Week is
feeling the same
thing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Facing her dream head-on, huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: All right, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: All right, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Great work, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know,
that's especially true for
you, Spe! It's like your
engine was on FULL
BLAAAST! I had a hard time keeping up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's kinda weird, but my body was
just bubbling with energy
today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If this keeps up, your performance at the
Takarazuka Kinen is sure to
impress!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's end the spring on a high note
with a win!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's end the spring on a high note
with a win!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, actually... Trainer,
I have a request of
sorts!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Suzuka is doing her best in
America, and the same goes
for El in
France. They've got lots of fans cheering
them on.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
As racers trained in Japan, naturally
they're representing the whole nation on
the world stage, and the fans are eager to
see them
succeed.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when I mentioned that
the key to being the best racer in Japan
might be to become an Umamusume who
makes
everyone smile?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I think Suzuka and El are exactly the type
of Umamusume I want to
be.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a racer worth supporting—one
who takes all of her fans'
dreams and
makes them come true. So if I win the
Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to follow El's example and take on
the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No wonder you were workin' overtime at
practice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you haven't changed one bit since
you joined us. Your dreams
are always on
such a grand scale, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like her teammates, I have trouble
concealing my surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, one look into Special Week's
eyes tells me how serious she
is. She's
ready to make her dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did say you needed to aim for
the top if you want your
dream to come
true.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did say you needed to aim for
the top if you want your
dream to come
true.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But if you want to be a racer worthy of
your fans' dreams... You have
to show them
you can make those dreams come true
first.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But if you want to be a racer worthy of
your fans' dreams... You have
to show them
you can make those dreams come true
first.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To become an Umamusume worthy of her
fans' dreams... and one who
can make
those dreams come true...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her international debut now hinging
on the Takarazuka Kinen, Special Week
buckles down and approaches her training
with
renewed vigor.
